description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Forms the route key together with dest; only the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA)

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Includes cancelled flights; ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Average departure delay in minutes across non-cancelled flights on the route (negative values indicate early departures).
transformation_or_derivation: Grouped by origin and dest, then aggregated using .mean() (ignoring missing values).
notes_or_concerns: Missing for routes where all scheduled flights were cancelled. Also suffers from data leakage because departure delays are unknown before the schedule season starts.

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes (target)
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Averages only flights with a recorded arrival delay; missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative means early on average

description: Maximum arrival delay in minutes recorded across completed flights on the route.
transformation_or_derivation: Grouped by origin and dest, then aggregated using .max() (ignoring missing values).
notes_or_concerns: Negative values (down to -22 min) occur on low-volume routes where all flights arrived early; missing for 100%-cancelled routes (e.g., LGA-LEX); suffers from data leakage and cannot be used as a pre-season predictor.

description: Average flight distance in miles between the origin and destination airports.
transformation_or_derivation: Grouped by origin and dest, then aggregated using .mean().
notes_or_concerns: No missing values; safe to use as a pre-season predictor since route distance is known prior to scheduling.

description: Average airborne time in minutes across completed flights on the route.
transformation_or_derivation: Grouped by origin and dest, then aggregated using .mean() (ignoring missing values).
notes_or_concerns: Missing for routes where all scheduled flights were cancelled (e.g., LGA-LEX); reflects post-flight duration rather than scheduled block time.

description: Full name of the destination airport
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table

description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees of the destination airport.
transformation_or_derivation: Left-joined from airports to route_abt on dest == faa.
notes_or_concerns: Missing for US territory airports (SJU, BQN, PSE, STT) that are excluded from the domestic nycflights13.airports lookup table.

description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees of the destination airport.
transformation_or_derivation: Left-joined from airports to route_abt on dest == faa.
notes_or_concerns: Missing for US territory airports (SJU, BQN, PSE, STT) that are excluded from the domestic nycflights13.airports lookup table.
